structure: Part 4, Main import reason: the 7 traces of about-the-consignment.fit.spec.js › 'main import reason', every one opened and mined in full (actions, page requests, POST bodies, and DOM snapshots of each state). Traces: lists every reason with its hint (59 actions; reason page DOM at action 36, the pointer for the full page); a reason is optional to proceed (47 actions; POST at request 161, next page at action 34); internal market reveals the purposes and needs one (68 actions; reveal at 33, error at 45, success POST request 199); transhipment needs a destination country (67 actions; error at 44, POST 199); transit needs a port of exit and a destination country (67 actions; error at 43, POST 199); temporary admission horses needs a real exit date and a port of exit (76 actions; empty error at 44, 'real date' error at 57, both POST 200); the prototype seed route jumps straight to the reason page (46 actions; navigate at 31, redirect request 161, landing at 33). Every trace's beforeEach walks create-notification › live animals › origin (France, region code No) › commodity (cattle, Bos taurus) to /design-release-2.1/reason-for-import; those earlier pages belong to other parts. One page is in scope: reason-for-import ('Main import reason'), always shown for live animals after the commodity page. On it, one optional radios question (importReason, 5 reasons each with a hint) with four conditional reveals: Internal market › purpose radios (11 options, required once the reason is chosen); Transhipment or onward travel › destination country select (required); Transit › port of exit and destination country selects (both required); Temporary admission horses › exit date (MoJ date picker, required, must be a real date) and port of exit select (required). Re-entry has no reveal. Plus the seed route /design-release-2.1/prototype/reason-for-import. The slice stops at the page after the reason, consignment-details ('Commodity details'), which every successful submit reaches.

claims.quote: For animals intended for direct travel to a third country, that will stay only within the same port or airport in Great Britain while moving to another means of transport.

claims.statement: The 'Transit' reason carries a hint describing animals entering GB at one port or airport and leaving from a different one.
claims.quote: For animals moving through Great Britain for direct travel to a third country, that will enter Great Britain at one port or airport and leave from a different one within England, Scotland or Wales.

claims.statement: The 'Re-entry' reason carries the hint 'For animals authorised for re-entry, or rejected exports re-entering Great Britain.'
claims.quote: For animals authorised for re-entry, or rejected exports re-entering Great Britain.

claims.statement: The 'Temporary admission horses' reason carries the hint 'For horses authorised for temporary entry.'
claims.quote: For horses authorised for temporary entry.

claims.statement: Choosing 'Re-entry' reveals nothing further: it is the only reason without a conditional reveal (its radio has no aria-controls and no conditional block follows it).
claims.quote: <input class="govuk-radios__input" id="import-reason-4" name="importReason" type="radio" value="Re-entry" aria-describedby="import-reason-4-item-hint">

claims.statement: Choosing 'Internal market' reveals a second radios question, 'Purpose in the internal market' (field internalMarketPurpose, medium-size legend), nested inside the reason radios.
claims.quote: Purpose in the internal market

claims.statement: The internal market purpose options are, in order: Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift; Transfer of ownership - Rescue; Breeding; Research; Racing, competition, show or training; Approved premises or body; Companion animal not for resale or rehoming; Production; Slaughter; Fattening; Restocking.

claims.quote: Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift | Transfer of ownership - Rescue | Breeding | Research | Racing, competition, show or training | Approved premises or body | Companion animal not for resale or rehoming | Production | Slaughter | Fattening | Restocking
claims.note: Live animals with cattle (Bos taurus) chosen. Whether the list varies by commodity is not shown in this slice.

claims.statement: The purpose 'Transfer of ownership - Sale/gift' carries a hint about sale or transfer of ownership, including gifts.
claims.quote: Any movement of an animal that has as its aim the sale of or the transfer of ownership of the animal from one person or entity to another. For example, animals that have been sold and are being moved to a new owner or will be sold once in Great Britain, purchases from a breeder/shop overseas and where an animal is being moved to a new owner with no sale involved (for example a gift).

claims.statement: The purpose 'Transfer of ownership - Rescue' carries a hint about rehoming, adoption and fostering.
claims.quote: Ownership of animal/s changes from one person or entity to another through rehoming and is adopted/fostered by new families, with or without an exchange or donation of money.

claims.statement: The purpose 'Breeding' carries a hint about animals for reproduction.
claims.quote: Animals for reproduction. This includes animals intended to contribute to the genetic pool of a breeding program, improve livestock quality, or produce offspring.

claims.statement: The purpose 'Research' carries the hint 'Animals for use in scientific or medical research.'
claims.quote: Animals for use in scientific or medical research.

claims.statement: The purpose 'Racing, competition, show or training' carries the hint 'Animals to participate in competitive or training events.'
claims.quote: Animals to participate in competitive or training events.

claims.statement: The purpose 'Approved premises or body' carries a hint about exhibitions, zoos, collections or conservation needing a licence or approval.
claims.quote: Animals for exhibition, zoos, collections, or conservation programmes where a licence or approval is needed.

claims.statement: The purpose 'Companion animal not for resale or rehoming' carries a hint about privately owned animals imported under the commercial rules.
claims.quote: Privately owned animals being imported under the commercial rules as the animal is unable to meet the non-commercial requirements, for example, one or more animals being transported by a commercial transporter without their owner or an authorised person, owner that is not traveling within five days of the animals' movement or a group of five or more animals being accompanied by their owner.

claims.statement: The purpose 'Production' carries a hint about animals farmed for meat, milk, eggs, wool or other products.
claims.quote: Animals that are farmed for the production of meat, milk, eggs, wool or any other animal product or by-product.

claims.statement: The purpose 'Slaughter' carries a hint about slaughter shortly after arrival into Great Britain.
claims.quote: Animals to be slaughtered and processed for meat production shortly after arrival into Great Britain.

claims.statement: The purpose 'Fattening' carries the hint 'Animals to be fattened for meat production.'
claims.quote: Animals to be fattened for meat production.

claims.statement: The purpose 'Restocking' carries a hint about replenishing populations, for example game or fish.
claims.quote: To replenish or enhance populations of species, for example, restocking of game or fish.

claims.statement: The exit date uses the MoJ date picker (moj-datepicker): a single text input with a 'Choose date' calendar toggle that opens a dialog with previous/next year and month buttons and 'Select' and 'Close' buttons. This is outside govuk-frontend; the GOV.UK date input (separate day, month and year boxes) is the standard alternative.

claims.statement: The reason page makes no data calls: the country and port lists come rendered in the page, and the only other traffic is the Prototype Kit's live-reload socket on localhost:3011.
claims.ref: trace lists-every-reason-with-its-hint requests (all, assets excluded): page documents plus localhost:3011 EIO polling/websocket and page-loaded
claims.quote: GET 200 localhost:3011?EIO=4&transport=polling
claims.note: Inferred from the network log. The real service would need port-of-exit (border control post) and country reference data; this prototype holds them in its own templates.

claims.statement: The prototype-only seed route /design-release-2.1/prototype/reason-for-import redirects (302) to /design-release-2.1/reason-for-import, which shows the 'Main import reason' heading with no reason preselected and the same back link.

claims.statement: The seed route is only exercised after a draft already exists in the session (the beforeEach has just walked to the reason page), so what it seeds from a fresh session is not shown.
No trace returns to the reason page after saving, so whether a saved reason and its reveal answers are shown again (and whether changing the reason clears the old reveal answers) is not shown.
Re-entry is never selected and submitted in this slice, so whether it needs anything further is not shown beyond the absence of a reveal.
The seed route keeps the draft already in the session: the reason page shows the same reference (GBN-AG-26-0ZNDNN) before and after the user goes to /design-release-2.1/prototype/reason-for-import.
